subject: Confirming payor & procurement kickoff — next steps
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Barnes <alicia.barnes@stellardata.com>, Tom Yeo <tom.yeo@stellardata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2027 14:03:00 -0500
Subject: Confirming payor & procurement kickoff — next steps

Hi Alicia / Tom — thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

1) Why we think Redwood helps: predictable inference costs for batched workloads, SLOs for latency-sensitive routes, and a private deployment path for regulated data.

2) Confirmed on call: Alicia is initial champion; Tom you oversee infra and budget governance. We need to confirm the formal economic buyer / budget owner and the procurement contact who will own contract/PO.

3) Action items I can own: send a short pricing snapshot + example SOW and propose a procurement kickoff slot. I attached a concise MVP pricing deck.

Proposed timeline: procurement kickoff next week (Mon/Tue preferred), 30–45 min — agenda: scope, billing model (reserved vs usage), timeline for pilot, security/compliance checklist owners.

Can you please confirm: a) who will sign the PO (name/title), and b) the correct procurement email to loop in? If it helps, cc procurement@stellardata.com and we will include our SOW template.

Thanks — Rishi

—
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0189

From: Alicia Barnes <alicia.barnes@stellardata.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Yeo <tom.yeo@stellardata.com>, procurement@stellardata.com
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2027 15:21:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Confirming payor & procurement kickoff — next steps

Thanks Rishi — great summary. Confirmation below: 

- Economic buyer / signer: Tom Yeo (VP, Infrastructure). He owns the FY28 inference budget and will be the person to approve spend > $100k.
- Procurement contact: procurement@stellardata.com (that goes to our centralized procurement team; please include a SOW and a sample PO path).

We are aiming to start a small pilot in January, budget window approved at a high level but Tom will need an SOW + procurement terms to move to PO.

Two quick asks from our side: 
- Can you include a brief line on data residency and audit logging in the SOW? Procurement will flag it otherwise.
- Any standard SOC2 evidence you can share while procurement reviews the SOW would be helpful.

I'll be on the kickoff too. Mondays after 11am ET work best for me.

Alicia
Director, Platform Partnerships
Stellar Data

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alicia Barnes <alicia.barnes@stellardata.com>, Tom Yeo <tom.yeo@stellardata.com>, procurement@stellardata.com
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2027 08:09:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Confirming payor & procurement kickoff — next steps

Marissa / Hannah — Alicia confirmed Tom as the signer and procurement@stellardata.com as the contact. Please see Alicia's asks (data residency + SOC2 evidence).

Marissa: can you prepare the one-pager SOW + the pricing snapshot we discussed (keep initial pilot capped at $20k usage + 2-week ramp)? Attach the SOW and our example_sow-template.docx.
Hannah: can you pull the SOC2 summary + brief note on audit log retention and paste a short paragraph we can include in the SOW?

I'll propose two kickoff slots to Alicia: Monday 12/20 11:00–11:45 ET or Tuesday 12/21 14:00–14:45 ET. Which do you prefer for presenting (Marissa to lead pricing + procurement flow, Hannah to cover security notes)?

Thanks — Rishi

Perfect — thanks for confirming, Alicia. We can take this on. 

Committed actions from Redwood: 
- I attached the MVP pricing snapshot and our SOW template (example_sow-template.docx).
- Hannah: I included a short SOC2/Security blurb under section 4 and a data residency paragraph (we support multi-region controls; we will call out audit log retention of 180 days by default; longer retention available on request).
- I'll run the SOW by legal for a quick check and send a redline-ready copy to procurement@stellardata.com by EOD.

Proposed kickoff: Tuesday 12/21 14:00–14:45 ET — Alicia, Tom, does that work? If Tom prefers, we can do Mon 12/20 11:00 ET instead.
